L1498 has a central density of ≈ 104 cm-2, a nearly isothermal gas temperature of 10 K, and a mean N2D+ abundance of 10-10, which is consistent with a chemically evolved but dynamically young source.
the density and temperature profile of the pre-protostar L1498 is consistent with a Bonnor-Ebert sphere with R0 = 0.3 pc and n = 1-3 × 104 cm−3, and a nearly constant temperature of ≈10.4 K.
